description: Classical yoga strength from the birth chart with the reason behind every point, plus the granth summary (saar): government job / UPSC / IAS, foreign settlement, foreign spouse / NRI marriage, marriage timing (shadi kab hogi), children (santan), second marriage, love or arranged marriage. Free view; full report with timing windows and remedies is on Trikaal Vaani.

gender.description: Required for marriage_timing and foreign_spouse (karaka differs: Venus for men, Jupiter for women)

latitude.description: Birthplace latitude in decimal degrees (e.g. New Delhi 28.6139)

longitude.description: Birthplace longitude in decimal degrees (e.g. New Delhi 77.2090)

time.description: Time of birth, 24-hour HH:MM (local time at birthplace). 12:00 is the conventional value when the exact time is unknown.

timezone.description: UTC offset in hours at birth (India = 5.5)

name: yog_check
title: Yog check (life questions)
